title.zh: 孟图霍特普二世与哈托尔

alt.en: Painted figures and hieroglyphs across a long limestone relief.
alt.zh: 长条石灰岩浮雕上保存着彩绘人物与象形文字。

caption.en: Mentuhotep II and Hathor, from his Deir el-Bahri temple, about 2010–2000 BCE.
caption.zh: 孟图霍特普二世与哈托尔，出自其代尔巴哈里神庙，约公元前2010—2000年。

interpretation.en: Hathor’s image was damaged in the Amarna period and restored in antiquity. The surviving surface records several stages of royal and religious history.
interpretation.zh: 哈托尔像在阿玛尔纳时期遭破坏，后在古代修补。现存表面记录了王权与宗教历史的多个阶段。

caption.zh: 献给“无名神”的石灰岩祭坛，约公元232年，可能来自帕尔米拉。

title.zh: 滑铁卢捷报传到切尔西

alt.en: Veterans, women and children gather outside a public house as news is read.
alt.zh: 退伍军人、妇女和儿童聚集在酒馆外听人宣读消息。

caption.en: John Burnet’s 1831 engraving after David Wilkie’s 1822 painting imagines Chelsea pensioners receiving news of Waterloo.
caption.zh: 约翰·伯内特1831年依戴维·威尔基1822年画作制作的版画，描绘切尔西退伍军人听到滑铁卢战报的场面。

interpretation.en: Find the reader at the centre and follow the listeners’ reactions. Victory becomes a shared story through newspapers, gathering and conversation.
interpretation.zh: 寻找中央的读报者，再观察听众的反应：胜利通过报纸、聚集与交谈成为共同的故事。

title.en: A hostile British image of the Paris Commune
title.zh: 英国反对巴黎公社的讽刺画

alt.en: A horned figure appears amid flames, smoke and a long printed text.
alt.zh: 有角的形象出现在火焰、烟雾和大段印刷文字之间。

caption.en: George Cruikshank’s hostile political etching about the Paris Commune, published in London in June 1871.
caption.zh: 乔治·克鲁克香克反对巴黎公社的政治蚀刻画，1871年6月在伦敦出版。

interpretation.en: The demon and flames are the artist’s political accusation. Compare the image’s language of catastrophe with the accompanying printed argument.
interpretation.zh: 恶魔与火焰表达画家的政治指控。比较画面中的灾难意象与旁边印刷文字的论述。

title.en: Tokyo bridges, traffic and a bank
title.zh: 东京的桥梁、交通与银行

alt.en: A colour woodblock sheet juxtaposes a crowded bridge with an ornate Western-style building.
alt.zh: 彩色木版画把拥挤的桥面与华丽的西式建筑并置。

caption.en: A colour woodcut by Utagawa Kunisada II shows Tokyo traffic and the First National Bank; the collection dates it approximately to 1870.
caption.zh: 歌川国贞二代的彩色木版画呈现东京交通与第一国立银行；馆藏将其约定为1870年。

interpretation.en: Compare the crowded bridge above with the mixed architectural styles below. The two views place everyday movement beside the institutions of early Meiji change.
interpretation.zh: 比较上方拥挤的桥面与下方混合风格的建筑：两幅场景把日常流动与明治初期的新机构并置。

title.en: Qutb Minar and its surrounding monuments

alt.en: A tall tapering minaret rises above ruins and a domed tomb in a broad landscape.
alt.zh: 高耸渐细的尖塔立于遗迹和圆顶陵墓之间。

caption.en: Ghulam Ali Khan’s watercolour of Qutb Minar and neighbouring monuments, around 1820.
caption.zh: 古拉姆·阿里·汗约1820年绘制的古特卜塔及邻近古迹水彩画。

interpretation.en: The tower dominates a landscape of ruins and tombs. Its nineteenth-century surroundings reveal how the Delhi Sultanate’s architecture remained visible long after its ruling houses had fallen.
interpretation.zh: 高塔俯瞰遗迹与陵墓。19世纪的周边景观呈现德里苏丹国建筑在其统治家族消亡后仍然可见的遗产。

alt.en: Workers and equipment occupy a long excavated channel through an arid landscape.
alt.zh: 工人与设备分布在穿过干旱地带的长形开挖河道中。

caption.en: Mason Jackson’s wood engraving of Suez Canal construction, around 1864, five years before the opening.
caption.zh: 梅森·杰克逊约1864年制作的苏伊士运河施工木刻画，早于通航约五年。

interpretation.en: Trace the channel into the distance, then locate the workers and equipment. The small figures give a sense of the scale of the excavation.
interpretation.zh: 沿河道望向远方，再寻找工人与设备：小小的人物衬托出开挖工程的规模。

alt.zh: 石柱与墙体矗立于散落的石块和建筑残件之上。

caption.en: Petros Moraites photographed the Acropolis around 1870, including parts of the Propylaea and Temple of Athena Nike.
caption.zh: 彼得罗斯·莫赖蒂斯约1870年拍摄雅典卫城，画面包含山门与雅典娜胜利神庙的部分遗迹。

interpretation.en: Standing columns and fallen blocks share the frame. Compare the monument’s surviving structure with the scattered stone in the foreground.
interpretation.zh: 直立的柱子与倒落的石块同在画面中。比较遗迹保留下来的结构与前景散落的石材。

title.en: A later vision of the Baths of Diocletian
title.zh: 后世描绘的戴克里先浴场

alt.en: A coloured architectural view arranges a vast bath complex around gardens and courtyards.
alt.zh: 彩色建筑图把庞大浴场建筑排列在花园和庭院周围。

caption.en: A coloured engraving of the Baths of Diocletian, around 1804–1811, presents a later architectural reconstruction.
caption.zh: 约1804—1811年的戴克里先浴场彩色版画，以后世建筑复原图呈现古代浴场。

interpretation.en: The symmetrical plan organizes large halls, courtyards and colonnades. What does this bird’s-eye arrangement make easier to understand about an imperial public building?
interpretation.zh: 对称布局组织起大厅、庭院与柱廊。这种鸟瞰式排列如何帮助理解帝国公共建筑？

alt.zh: 受损的多层建筑矗立在瓦砾与裸露地面之间。

caption.en: Felice Beato’s photograph of the damaged Lucknow Residency, around 1858, after fighting during the Indian Rebellion.
caption.zh: 费利切·比托约1858年拍摄的勒克瑙英国驻地，在印度起义战斗中受损。

interpretation.en: Look at the broken rooflines, exposed rooms and rubble. The photograph makes the fighting’s material aftermath visible within a colonial photographic record.
interpretation.zh: 观察破损屋顶、外露房间与瓦砾：这张殖民时代照片记录了战斗留下的物质痕迹。

alt.en: Boats sit in a broad harbour beneath a warm evening sky.
alt.zh: 船只停在温暖暮色笼罩的宽阔港湾中。

caption.en: J. Taylor’s 1879 watercolour shows Singapore harbour, one of the three ports grouped as the Straits Settlements in 1826.
caption.zh: J. 泰勒1879年的水彩画描绘新加坡港，它是1826年组成海峡殖民地的三个港口之一。

interpretation.en: Compare the low boats in the foreground with the taller masts offshore. The harbour gathers different kinds of vessels within one sheltered view.
interpretation.zh: 比较前景的小船与近海高耸的桅杆：港湾把不同类型的船只汇集在同一幅景象中。

alt.en: Junks with tall masts lie offshore under dark rain clouds.
alt.zh: 高桅帆船停在近海，天空笼罩深色雨云。

caption.en: J. Taylor’s 1879 watercolour shows Chinese junks in the rain off Tanjong Katong, Singapore.
caption.zh: J. 泰勒1879年的水彩画，描绘新加坡丹戎加东近海雨中的中国帆船。

interpretation.en: Compare this rain-darkened coast with Taylor’s sunset harbour. Sails, weather and distance produce two different views of the same port city.
interpretation.zh: 将这幅雨云笼罩的海岸与泰勒笔下的日落港湾对照：风帆、天气与距离构成同一港城的两种景象。

title.en: Law of the Land: constitutional documents
Sugar work from field to boiling house
title.zh: 从蔗田到煮糖房的劳动

alt.en: Workers cut and carry cane beside a mill and a long boiling house.
alt.zh: 工人在磨坊和长形煮糖房旁砍伐、搬运甘蔗。

caption.en: A 1683 engraving after Leclerc’s design of about 1671 follows sugar production from cane fields to processing equipment.
caption.zh: 1683年版画依据勒克莱尔约1671年的设计，将蔗田与加工器具组织在同一画面。

interpretation.en: Cutting, carrying, milling and boiling appear in one ordered composition. Compare the visible skilled tasks with the coercive labour system described in the story.
interpretation.zh: 砍伐、搬运、碾压与煮糖被组织在一幅有序构图中。把可见的熟练工序与故事中的强制劳动制度对照阅读。

title.zh: 运河委员会旅馆的餐厅

alt.en: Diners sit at rows of tables under the rafters of a large dining hall.
alt.zh: 就餐者坐在大餐厅屋架下的一排排餐桌旁。

caption.en: American and European canal workers dining at Culebra, about 1910, as identified by the collection.
caption.zh: 约1910年库莱布拉的运河工人用餐；馆藏辨识为美国及欧洲劳动者。

interpretation.en: Rows of tables turn meals into an organized service. Compare this large dining hall with the workers’ households at Cristóbal.
interpretation.zh: 成排餐桌显示有组织的用餐服务。把这间大餐厅与克里斯托瓦尔的工人住房对照起来。

alt.en: Wooden dwellings line a raised walkway, with children and other residents outside.
alt.zh: 木制住房排列在架高的步道两侧，孩子与其他居民站在屋外。

caption.en: Housing for West Indian and Panamanian canal workers at Cristóbal, about 1910, with children in the walkway.
caption.zh: 约1910年克里斯托瓦尔的西印度与巴拿马运河工人住房，步道上可见儿童。

interpretation.en: Wooden dwellings open onto shared raised walkways. The children make household life visible within the history of a construction workforce.
interpretation.zh: 木制住房面向共用的架高步道。孩子的身影让家庭生活进入工程劳工的历史。

alt.zh: 雕刻立面从红褐色峭壁中耸起，旁有小幅人物，前景为岩石地面。

caption.en: Haghe’s 1849 lithograph after Roberts presents Petra’s surviving rock-cut architecture.
caption.zh: 哈格依罗伯茨作品制作的1849年石版画，描绘佩特拉留存的岩凿建筑。

interpretation.en: The small figures accentuate the scale of carved façades and cliffs. Follow where masonry-like architectural forms emerge from the rock itself.
interpretation.zh: 小幅人物衬出雕凿立面与峭壁的尺度。观察仿佛砌筑的建筑形式，怎样直接从岩体中浮现。

title.zh: 伊散德尔瓦纳之后的英国教训

alt.en: A Zulu man writes “Despise not your enemy” on a blackboard before a seated British figure.
alt.zh: 一名祖鲁男子在黑板上写下“不要轻视你的敌人”，一名英国形象坐在前方。

caption.en: An 1879 British cartoon turns the defeat at Isandlwana into a lesson against underestimating an opponent.
caption.zh: 1879年英国讽刺画把伊散德尔瓦纳战败化为轻敌的教训。

interpretation.en: The chalkboard reverses the roles of teacher and pupil. British complacency is the target, while the figures retain the stereotypes of British imperial satire.
interpretation.zh: 黑板将教师与学生的角色颠倒：英国的自满受到讽刺，人物仍带有英国帝国讽刺画的刻板形象。

title.en: Tongan boats in a voyage engraving
title.zh: 航海版画中的汤加船只

alt.en: Large sailing vessels and smaller canoes occupy a choppy sea beneath dark clouds.
alt.zh: 大型帆船与较小的独木舟航行在乌云下起伏的海面上。

caption.en: Tongan sailing vessels in a 1777 engraving after observations made during Cook’s second voyage.
caption.zh: 1777年版画中的汤加帆船，依据库克第二次航行期间的观察绘制。

interpretation.en: Compare the tall sails, low hulls and smaller canoes. This European voyage image gives maritime mobility a visible form within the story of island connections.
interpretation.zh: 比较高帆、低矮船身与小型独木舟。这幅欧洲航海图像，让岛际联系中的海上流动获得具体形态。

title.en: Kava and chiefly authority on Tongatapu
title.zh: 汤加塔布的卡瓦饮礼与首领权威

alt.en: A crowd sits in a large roofed hall around a central ceremonial gathering.
alt.zh: 人群坐在宽大的有顶大厅内，围绕中央的仪式聚会。

caption.en: A 1784 engraving of kava ceremony and deference to Tuʻi Tonga Paulaho; the collection tentatively connects it to June 1777.
caption.zh: 1784年版画表现卡瓦饮礼及对图伊汤加保拉霍的敬礼；馆方暂将场景系于1777年6月。

interpretation.en: Rows of seated figures direct attention toward the central ceremony. The composition makes social rank visible alongside the seafaring technology in the paired boat image.
interpretation.zh: 成排而坐的人群把视线引向中央仪式。构图使社会等级可见，与另一幅船图中的航海技术形成对读。

alt.en: A seated bronze Buddha fills the image above an offering table and incense vessels.
alt.zh: 端坐的铜佛占据画面主体，下方有供桌与香器。

caption.en: Beato’s photograph of Kamakura’s surviving Great Buddha, cataloged about 1868.
caption.zh: 比托拍摄镰仓留存的大佛，馆藏定年约1868年。

interpretation.en: Offerings, vessels and trees surround the monumental seated figure. The later photograph records a surviving Buddhist sculpture in Kamakura’s changing religious landscape.
interpretation.zh: 供物、器皿与树木围绕巨大的坐像。这幅较晚照片记录了镰仓宗教景观中留存的佛教雕塑。

caption.en: Bangkok seen in Thomson’s 1865 negative, reproduced in this 1981 photographic print.
caption.zh: 汤姆森1865年底片记录的曼谷，此件照片于1981年印制。

interpretation.en: Layered temple roofs lead the eye toward the Chao Phraya River and its far bank. Religious buildings and river access share the same capital landscape.
interpretation.zh: 层叠寺院屋顶把视线引向湄南河与远岸。宗教建筑和河流通道共同构成都城景观。

alt.en: An engraved bust shows Béhanzin holding a long pipe, with a patterned cloth over one shoulder.
alt.zh: 版画半身像中的贝汉津手持长烟斗，花纹织物披在一侧肩上。

caption.en: Béhanzin holds a pipe in an undated wood engraving after a photograph taken following his surrender.
caption.zh: 未纪年木刻中的贝汉津手持烟斗；底本照片摄于他投降之后。

interpretation.en: The printed account places the captive king aboard a French warship. Portrait and caption show how the conquest of Dahomey was presented to a colonial audience.
interpretation.zh: 版面记述把被拘禁的国王置于法国军舰上。肖像与文字共同显示殖民读者如何接触达荷美被征服的消息。

alt.en: Brougham faces a group of Black figures while children beside a smoking factory appeal to him from behind.
alt.zh: 布鲁厄姆面朝一群黑人形象，身后冒烟工厂旁的儿童向他呼吁。

caption.en: Henry Heath places Brougham between racist caricatures of emancipated people and protesting factory children.
caption.zh: 亨利·希思把布鲁厄姆置于遭种族主义丑化的获解放者形象与抗议的工厂儿童之间。

interpretation.en: The speech bubbles make emancipation and factory reform competing claims on attention. They express the satirist’s argument, not the depicted people’s testimony. The tentative catalogue date, 1832?, conflicts with the reference to compensation under the 1833 abolition legislation; the year remains unresolved.
interpretation.zh: 对白把殖民地解放与工厂改革表现为争夺关注的诉求。这是讽刺画作者的论点，不是图中人物的证言。馆藏暂定的1832年？与画中涉及1833年废奴立法赔偿的文字冲突，年份仍未确定。

title.en: Carding cotton after the Factory Act

alt.en: Women and children stand beside large carding machines, driving belts and tall cylindrical containers.
alt.zh: 妇女与儿童站在大型梳棉机、传动带和高筒形容器旁。

caption.en: Women and children operate cotton-carding machines in this 1840 print after J. R. Barfoot.
caption.zh: 这幅1840年依据J.R.巴富特作品制作的版画，描绘妇女与儿童操作梳棉机。

interpretation.en: Belts and cylinders organize a sequence of tasks performed by the workers. The later print shows the workplace addressed by factory reform, while working hours and enforcement require written records.
interpretation.zh: 传动带与滚筒组织起工人完成的一系列操作。这幅较晚的版画呈现工厂改革所针对的劳动场所，工时与执法情况则需结合文字档案。

在古巴近海截获“埃米利亚”号

alt.en: Several sailing ships and small boats gather around a large vessel beneath a clouded sky.
alt.zh: 多艘帆船和小艇聚集在一艘大船周围，天空布满云层。

caption.en: An 1858 engraving shows the Royal Navy intercepting the slave ship Emilia off Cuba, after an officer’s sketch.
caption.zh: 1858年版画依据军官速写，描绘英国海军在古巴近海截获贩奴船“埃米利亚”号。

interpretation.en: The ships dominate the composition; the people being transported are almost invisible. This naval view documents an Atlantic trade that continued after Britain abolished its own slave trade.
interpretation.zh: 舰船占据构图中心，被运送者几乎不可见。这幅海军视角的图像记录了英国废除本国奴隶贸易后仍在继续的大西洋贩运。

title.zh: 同一画面中的拉合尔与统治者

alt.en: A coloured panorama labels Lahore’s citadel and royal mosque above a small mounted procession.
alt.zh: 彩色全景在小型骑乘队伍上方，标注拉合尔的城堡与皇家清真寺。

caption.en: An undated northern view of Lahore places Ranjit Singh, identified by the catalogue, in the foreground.
caption.zh: 未纪年的拉合尔北面景观把馆藏所辨识的兰季特·辛格置于前景。

interpretation.en: Named buildings extend across the skyline while a small procession occupies the foreground. The composition links the ruler with the kingdom’s urban capital.
interpretation.zh: 具名建筑沿天际线延伸，前景则是一支小队伍。构图把统治者同王国都城连接起来。

后来的怀唐伊签署记述

alt.en: A worn blue pamphlet cover names William Colenso and the signing of the Treaty of Waitangi.
alt.zh: 磨损的蓝色册封标有威廉·科伦索姓名与怀唐伊条约签署主题。

caption.en: William Colenso’s account was published in Wellington in 1890, fifty years after the signing. This is its printed cover, not an 1840 treaty sheet.
caption.zh: 威廉·科伦索的记述于1890年在惠灵顿出版，距签署已五十年。这是书册封面，并非1840年的条约原件。

interpretation.en: The cover promises English and Māori treaty texts. Its claim to an authoritative history invites comparison with the differing texts and the perspectives of Māori signatories.
interpretation.zh: 封面说明书中收录英文和毛利文条约。其权威历史的自我定位，应与文本差异及毛利签署者的视角对读。

title.zh: 宪法颁布后的图普一世

alt.en: An elderly king stands with a walking stick beside a chair on mats in front of a veranda.
alt.zh: 年长的国王拄杖站在铺席上，身旁有椅子，身后是门廊。

caption.en: Alfred Burton photographed George Tupou I on 26 July 1884. The portrait postdates the king’s 1875 constitution; it does not show its proclamation.
caption.zh: 阿尔弗雷德·伯顿于1884年7月26日拍摄乔治·图普一世。肖像晚于国王1875年颁布宪法，并非颁宪现场。

interpretation.en: The cane, chair and formal coat stage royal presence in a domestic setting. The constitution reshaped institutions while retaining the king’s central authority.
interpretation.zh: 手杖、椅子与正式外衣，在居住环境中呈现王者身份。宪法改造制度的同时，保留了国王的核心权威。

title.en: A naval camp in the Waikato campaign
title.zh: 怀卡托战役中的海军营地

alt.en: Pale tents cluster beside tracks and a waterway beneath open hills.
alt.zh: 浅色帐篷聚集于小路与水道旁，后方是开阔丘陵。

caption.en: Daniel Beere’s 1864 photograph records the naval camp at Mangatāwhiri Creek. Te Papa places it in his series documenting sites of the Waikato campaign.
caption.zh: 丹尼尔·比尔1864年的照片记录了曼加塔菲里溪海军营地。蒂帕帕将其置于记录怀卡托战役地点的系列中。

interpretation.en: Tents and tracks make military occupation visible. The distant view does not show Māori experiences of the invasion or establish that the surrounding land was empty.
interpretation.zh: 帐篷与道路使军事占领可见。远景没有呈现毛利人的被侵略经历，也不能证明周围土地原本无人居住。

title.zh: 针对马乌运动的殖民传单

alt.en: A royal coat of arms heads a Samoan-language leaflet with three numbered claims and a governor’s name.
alt.zh: 萨摩亚文传单上方有王室纹章，下方列三项说法并署总督姓名。

caption.en: The New Zealand government issued this leaflet in Samoa on 10 February 1930. It used Nelson’s abandoned libel case to discredit the Mau movement.
caption.zh: 新西兰政府于1930年2月10日在萨摩亚发布此传单，借尼尔森撤回诽谤诉讼一事贬损马乌运动。

interpretation.en: The official crest and numbered assertions turn print into an instrument of colonial authority. These are the administration’s accusations, not an impartial account of the movement.
interpretation.zh: 官方纹章与编号论断，使印刷品成为殖民权力工具。这些是当局的指责，而非对运动的中立叙述。

alt.en: Openwork crosses sit within a circular band edged with small triangular loops above a hollow shaft.
alt.zh: 镂空十字置于圆环内，边缘饰小三角环，下接空心柄。

caption.en: This Ethiopian copper-alloy processional cross dates to the fourteenth–fifteenth century. Its hollow shaft fitted a pole used to carry it aloft.
caption.zh: 这件埃塞俄比亚铜合金巡游十字架作于十四至十五世纪。空心柄可套在长杆上，以便高举行进。

interpretation.en: Casting and openwork gave public worship a material form during the Early Solomonic period. The catalogue does not identify a royal patron or a specific original church.
interpretation.zh: 铸造与镂空技艺，使早期所罗门时期的公共礼拜具有物质形式。目录未确定王室委托者或最初所属教堂。

title.zh: 埃塞俄比亚抄本中的大卫

alt.en: A bearded figure in red and yellow robes holds a stringed instrument on a worn parchment leaf.
alt.zh: 磨损的羊皮纸页上，蓄须人物穿红黄衣袍，手持弦乐器。

caption.en: This fifteenth-century Ethiopian manuscript leaf represents King David with a stringed instrument. The museum relates it to the Psalms and notes calligraphy practice on its reverse.
caption.zh: 这页十五世纪埃塞俄比亚抄本描绘持弦乐器的大卫王。博物馆将其与《诗篇》联系，并指出背面有书法练习。

interpretation.en: The colored robes and carefully drawn strings reveal the labor of manuscript painting. This is medieval biblical imagery, not a portrait of a Solomonic Ethiopian ruler; its original monastery is not identified.
interpretation.zh: 彩色衣袍与细描琴弦体现抄本绘制劳动。这是中世纪圣经图像，并非埃塞俄比亚所罗门王朝君主的肖像；原属修道院未定。

title.zh: 卡尔纳克的托勒密三世门楼

alt.en: Ram sculptures line a sandy approach to a carved gateway, with several people standing in front.
alt.zh: 公羊雕像排列在沙土通道两侧，前方雕刻门楼下站着数人。

caption.en: Pascal Sébah photographed the surviving gateway of Ptolemy III at Karnak around 1875.
caption.zh: 帕斯卡尔·塞巴约于1875年拍摄卡尔纳克留存的托勒密三世门楼。

interpretation.en: Ram sculptures lead toward the carved gateway. Egyptian temple forms connect the dynasty to older religious institutions; the people and condition of the avenue belong to the much later photograph.
interpretation.zh: 公羊雕像把视线引向雕刻门楼。埃及神庙形式将王朝与更古老的宗教制度相连；画中人物与通道的保存状况，则属于很久之后的拍摄时刻。

alt.en: William IV poses beneath drapery with a rolled document in his right hand and a star on his coat.
alt.zh: 威廉四世在帷幕后摆姿，右手持卷轴，外套佩有星章。

caption.en: An 1830 mezzotint of William IV holding a scroll identified by the catalogue as Magna Carta.
caption.zh: 1830年威廉四世美柔汀肖像版画；馆藏目录将其所持卷轴辨识为《大宪章》。

interpretation.en: A nineteenth-century king presents himself through a charter born of conflict with a medieval king. The document’s later symbolic authority becomes visible in the pose and scroll.
interpretation.zh: 十九世纪国王借一份源自贵族与中世纪国王冲突的宪章塑造形象。姿态与卷轴呈现了这份文书后来获得的象征权威。

title.zh: 以“普拉西男爵”为名的克莱武

alt.en: A half-length portrait of Robert Clive bears a printed inscription naming him Baron of Plassey and commander of Company forces.
alt.zh: 罗伯特·克莱武半身像下的题字称他为普拉西男爵及公司军队统帅。

caption.en: An eighteenth-century print after Gainsborough, inscribed with Clive’s title “Baron of Plassey” and his Company offices. Its exact year is unrecorded.
caption.zh: 十八世纪依据庚斯博罗作品制作的版画，题记列克莱武“普拉西男爵”头衔及公司职务；具体年份未载。

interpretation.en: The inscription attaches the victory to one commander’s public identity. Compare that claim to status with the linked account of Indian soldiers, Mir Jafar and bankers.
interpretation.zh: 题记把胜利归入一位统帅的公共形象。可将这种地位宣示，与关联条目中印度士兵、米尔·贾法尔和银行家的作用对照。

title.zh: 延伸阅读：1757年：普拉西战役与公司的政治权力

date.zh: 十八世纪；目录年代范围为1700—1799年

creator.zh: C.科巴特，依据托马斯·庚斯博罗作品；约翰·鲍尔斯、罗伯特·塞耶与卡林顿·鲍尔斯出版

title.en: Patronage and instruments in the Royal Society’s image
title.zh: 皇家学会图像中的赞助与仪器

alt.en: Brouncker and Bacon flank a bust of Charles II beneath a winged figure; books, globes and instruments fill the arches.
alt.zh: 布龙克与培根分列查理二世胸像两旁，上方有带翼人物，拱门内布满书籍、地球仪与仪器。

caption.en: Hollar’s 1667 allegory, after Evelyn, places Brouncker and Francis Bacon beside Charles II’s bust. Bacon had died before the Society’s foundation.
caption.zh: 霍拉尔1667年依据伊夫林设计的寓意图，将布龙克与弗朗西斯·培根置于查理二世胸像旁；培根在学会创立前已经去世。

interpretation.en: Books, globes and instruments surround royal authority. Their arrangement joins patronage, intellectual ancestry and practical investigation in a symbolic institutional portrait.
interpretation.zh: 书籍、地球仪与仪器围绕王权形象排列，将赞助、思想源流与实践研究组合成象征性的机构肖像。

title.zh: 延伸阅读：皇家学会：共同记录与讨论实验

creator.zh: 文策斯劳斯·霍拉尔，依据约翰·伊夫林作品

context.en: The Ban Zhao leaf is one part of the 1799 album commissioned by Cao Zhenxiu and painted by Gai Qi.
context.zh: 班昭图是1799年曹贞秀委托改琦绘制的画册中的一页。

context.en: This is the Chuquibamba star-patterned tunic discussed in the story, Met 33.149.100.
context.zh: 这就是故事讨论的丘基班巴星纹织衣，大都会藏品号33.149.100。

context.en: This is the terracotta column surround discussed in the story, Met 1992.151.
context.zh: 这就是故事讨论的陶制柱饰，大都会藏品号1992.151。

context.en: This actual Persepolis palace relief makes the entry’s discussion of staged imperial order concrete: a Median figure joins a formal procession. It dates to about 405–359 BCE, not the reign of Cyrus or the first building campaign under Darius.
context.zh: 这块真实的波斯波利斯宫殿浮雕，以参加正式行列的米底人物，使本条关于帝国秩序展示的讨论具体化。它约制作于公元前405至359年，并非居鲁士在位或大流士最初营建时期。

context.en: The portrait identifies Queen Liliʻuokalani, whose government was overthrown in 1893 and whose protest continued afterward. The sitting was around 1891; the print’s 1916 inscription is later. It does not depict the overthrow itself.
context.zh: 肖像呈现1893年政府被推翻、此后继续抗议的利留卡拉尼女王。拍摄约在1891年，照片的1916年题字为后加，并非政变现场图。

context.en: Justinian’s name and Roman titles on this 521 consular ivory give material form to the inherited official traditions discussed in the legal-compilation entry. The object predates his imperial reign and the 529–534 compilation; it contains no law text.
context.zh: 521年执政官象牙板上的查士丁尼姓名与罗马官衔，使法律编纂条目所述继承的官职传统具有物质形式。它早于其帝王统治及529至534年编纂，不含法律正文。

context.en: The ivory names Justinian, the patron who ordered Hagia Sophia rebuilt. Its 521 consular display offers an earlier example of his public titles, before the church’s 532–537 rebuilding. It is neither architectural fabric nor a view of the church.
context.zh: 象牙板铭记下令重建圣索菲亚教堂的赞助者查士丁尼；521年执政官身份展示，早于532至537年教堂重建。它既非教堂建筑构件，也非教堂景观图。

context.en: Douglass spoke at the 1848 convention, and its report was printed at his North Star office. This portrait from about 1879 identifies the participant and publisher at a later stage of life, not his appearance at the meeting.
context.zh: 道格拉斯在1848年大会发言，大会报告也在其《北极星报》印刷所印制。这张约1879年的肖像呈现参与者与出版者晚年的面貌，并非会场时的样貌。

context.en: The 1776 Declaration supplied a rhetorical model for the 1848 Declaration of Sentiments. Viewing the earlier document invites comparison of whose equality each declaration claimed. This parchment is the Declaration of Independence, not the convention’s own statement.
context.zh: 1776年《独立宣言》为1848年《感伤宣言》提供修辞范本。观看较早文献，可比较两份宣言分别主张谁的平等。这张羊皮纸是《独立宣言》，而非大会自身声明。

context.en: Tagore founded the Santiniketan school in 1901. His approximately 1909 portrait identifies the educator behind the experiment during its early development, before Visva-Bharati’s 1921 foundation. It shows the founder, not the campus or a teaching session.
context.zh: 泰戈尔于1901年创办圣蒂尼克坦学校。约1909年的肖像呈现教育实验早期的创办者，早于1921年维斯瓦—巴拉蒂成立；它展示人物，并非校园或授课场景。

context.en: The Emancipation Proclamation was publicly read at Camp Saxton on 1 January 1863. This archival page connects the gathering to the named legal document; it is not the particular copy used at the camp or a visual record of the celebration.
context.zh: 1863年1月1日，萨克斯顿营地公开宣读《解放宣言》。这张档案书页将集会与该法律文献联系起来，但并非营地当时使用的那份副本，也非庆典图像记录。

context.en: The entry contrasts palace representations of order with administrative accounts. This Persepolis processional relief supplies the palace side of that comparison. It dates to about 405–359 BCE, later than the 509–494 BCE Fortification tablets, and is not a ration record.
context.zh: 本条将宫殿表现的秩序与行政账目对读；这块波斯波利斯行列浮雕提供宫殿一侧的比较材料。它约制作于公元前405至359年，晚于前509至494年的城防泥板，并非配给记录。

context.en: The surviving proclamation page is a primary document of Lincoln’s January 1863 action discussed in the biography. Its specified rebellious territories and exceptions help distinguish wartime emancipation from nationwide abolition.
context.zh: 存世宣言书页，是传记所述林肯1863年1月行动的原始文献。其指定叛乱地区及例外条款，有助于区分战时解放与全国废奴。

context.en: A Tang copy of the preface composed for the Orchid Pavilion gathering of 353.
context.zh: 353年兰亭雅集所作序文的唐代摹本。

context.en: The celebrated preface survives through later copies, including this Tang sheet attributed to Feng Chengsu.
context.zh: 著名序文经后世摹本流传，其中包括这件传为冯承素所作的唐摹本。

context.en: Chen Hongshou’s Returning Home imagines the poet whose resignation is described here. Its 1650 image belongs to the later reception of that choice.
context.zh: 陈洪绶《归去来》描绘本条辞官的诗人；1650年的画作属于后世对这一选择的理解。

context.en: Qu Yuan, the courtier in this entry, appears as a remembered poet in this Ming encyclopedia.
context.zh: 本条中的朝臣屈原，在这部明代百科图书中被塑造成后人记忆中的诗人。

context.en: The Ming print gives a later face to the poet whose exile and writing anchor this entry.
context.zh: 明代版画为本条放逐与创作故事的主角提供后世诗人形象。

context.en: A Yuan portrait of the author of Spring View, made centuries after the poem’s wartime setting.
context.zh: 《春望》作者的元代肖像，比诗中战乱背景晚数百年。

context.en: Du Fu in a Yuan portrait scroll, accompanying the story of his early Mount Tai poem.
context.zh: 元代立轴中的杜甫，与他早年泰山诗作的故事相联系。

context.en: This Yuan portrait of Du Fu pairs with the Song painting of Li Bai: two later images of poets who travelled together in 744–745.
context.zh: 这幅元代杜甫像与宋代李白图相对照：两位744至745年同游诗人的后世形象。

context.en: The retrospective scroll introduces Du Fu, whose family losses and official disappointments shaped his writing.
context.zh: 后世画卷呈现杜甫；家难与仕途失意塑造了他的写作。

context.en: A later portrait of the poet remembered through the Chengdu cottage and its poems.
context.zh: 后世杜甫像，使成都草堂及诗歌所纪念的诗人可见。

context.en: The Yuan portrait accompanies Du Fu’s Kuizhou years and the poems associated with them.
context.zh: 元代肖像与杜甫夔州时期及相关诗作相联系。

context.en: A commemorative portrait of the poet whose final travels are described here.
context.zh: 这幅纪念性肖像呈现本条晚年行旅中的诗人。

context.en: The Yuan album names Meng Ke, or Mencius, whose dialogue with King Hui contrasts profit and humane rule.
context.zh: 元代册页题名孟轲，即与梁惠王讨论利与仁义的孟子。

context.en: A Yuan image of Mencius as an honored teacher, linked here to his arguments about humane government.
context.zh: 元代孟子尊师形象，与本条讨论仁政的思想相联系。

context.en: The photographed scroll transcribes the Pipa Song named in this entry, showing the Tang poem’s later Ming calligraphic life.
context.zh: 照片中的手卷书写本条《琵琶行》，呈现唐诗在明代书法中的延续。

context.en: Jiang Xun’s later painting identifies Li Qingzhao, the collector and writer named here; flowers express her literary afterlife rather than inventorying the Qingzhou collection.
context.zh: 姜壎后世画作标识本条收藏者、词人李清照；花枝表达其文学接受史，而非罗列青州藏品。

context.en: The Qing painting commemorates Li Qingzhao, the writer named in this Jinhua episode, rather than illustrating a specific visit to Bayong Tower.
context.zh: 清代画作追怀本条金华经历中的李清照，并非描绘某次八咏楼之游。

context.en: The Song image commemorates the emperor installed after the fall of the Lü clan, showing the ideal of a ruler who hears advice.
context.zh: 宋代图像纪念吕氏覆亡后即位的汉文帝，呈现君主纳谏的理想。

context.en: The enthroned ruler is the Yongle emperor, who made Beijing the principal Ming capital.
context.zh: 宝座上的君主是永乐帝，他将北京定为明朝的主要都城。

context.en: The formal imperial image presents Zhu Di as sovereign after the Jingnan forces took Nanjing and he ascended the throne.
context.zh: 正式御容表现靖难军攻入南京、朱棣即位之后的皇帝身份。

context.en: Lin Zexu is the commissioner who supervised the destruction of confiscated opium at Humen.
context.zh: 林则徐是主持在虎门销毁所缴鸦片的钦差大臣。

context.en: Sima Guang is the historian at the center of this entry on compiling the Zizhi Tongjian in Luoyang.
context.zh: 司马光是此条目中在洛阳编纂《资治通鉴》的核心史家。

context.en: The portrait introduces Sima Guang as a participant in the correspondence with Wang Anshi over the New Policies.
context.zh: 此像呈现与王安石通过书信讨论新法的司马光。

context.en: The seated sovereign is Zhao Kuangyin, the military leader who became Song emperor after the Chenqiao mutiny.
context.zh: 端坐的君主是赵匡胤，即陈桥兵变后建立宋朝的军事首领。

context.en: The portrait identifies Emperor Yang, whose government ordered the Yongji Canal connecting the Yellow River with Zhuo Commandery.
context.zh: 图中人物为隋炀帝，其政府下令开凿连接黄河与涿郡的永济渠。

context.en: The Yuan album commemorates Temüjin, who took the title Genghis Khan as the Mongol political order was consolidated in 1206.
context.zh: 元代帝像册纪念铁木真；1206年蒙古政治秩序整合时，他取得成吉思汗称号。

context.en: The dynasty’s portrait of Genghis Khan anchors the entry’s opening discussion of unification in 1206 and the conquests that followed.
context.zh: 王朝绘制的成吉思汗像，与条目开篇讨论的1206年统一及随后征服相联系。

context.en: The imperial album portrait identifies Kublai, who proclaimed the dynastic name Great Yuan in 1271.
context.zh: 帝王像册中的人物为忽必烈，他于1271年定国号为“大元”。

context.en: The Qing ancestral portrait commemorates Nurhaci, who established the Later Jin khanate at Hetu Ala.
context.zh: 清代祖先御容纪念在赫图阿拉建立后金汗国的努尔哈赤。

context.en: Hong Taiji’s imperial dress connects directly to the proclamation of Qing and his assumption of the emperor’s title at Shengjing.
context.zh: 皇太极的帝王朝服，与他在盛京称帝并定国号为清的事件直接相连。

context.en: This court portrait identifies the Yongzheng emperor, under whose rule the Grand Council emerged as a central decision-making institution.
context.zh: 宫廷御容呈现雍正帝；其统治时期形成了作为中枢决策机构的军机处。

context.en: The later photograph identifies Li Hongzhang, one of the officials named in the foundation of the Jiangnan Arsenal.
context.zh: 较晚拍摄的照片呈现李鸿章，他是条目所述创办江南制造总局的官员之一。

context.en: Li Hongzhang, photographed in 1896, was the Qing negotiator who signed the Chefoo Convention two decades earlier.
context.zh: 1896年照片中的李鸿章，是二十年前签订《烟台条约》的清方谈判代表。

context.en: The 1875 portrait shows Zuo Zongtang, whose earlier memorial launched the Fuzhou shipbuilding and naval-education project.
context.zh: 1875年照片呈现左宗棠；此前他的奏请促成福州造船与海军教育事业。

context.en: The later printed portrait identifies Fan Zhongyan, a leader of the Qingli reforms named in this entry.
context.zh: 后世版画标识此条目所述庆历新政主持者范仲淹。

context.en: The portrait commemorates Fan Zhongyan, author of the Memorial to Yueyang Tower discussed here.
context.zh: 此像纪念本条目所述《岳阳楼记》的作者范仲淹。

context.en: This later artistic portrait identifies Xiang Yu, the commander associated here with the victory at Julu.
context.zh: 这幅后世艺术肖像呈现条目中巨鹿战役的统帅项羽。

context.en: Xiang Yu is one of the named leaders of the Jiangdong uprising; the portrait shows his later artistic reputation.
context.zh: 项羽是条目点名的江东起事领袖之一；肖像呈现他的后世艺术形象。

context.en: The 1918 reproduction identifies Zeng Guofan, the organizer of the Xiang Army discussed in this entry.
context.zh: 1918年刊载的肖像呈现本条目所述湘军组织者曾国藩。

context.en: The printed portrait names Zeng Guofan, one of the Xiang Army leaders in this account of Tianjing’s fall.
context.zh: 印刷肖像题名曾国藩，他是此处天京陷落叙述所提及的湘军领袖之一。

context.en: The illustrated narrative’s Wang Mang is the ruler who proclaimed the Xin dynasty in this entry.
context.zh: 通俗叙事中的王莽像对应本条目中建立新朝的统治者。

context.en: The hostile later portrait introduces Wang Mang, whose land and currency policies are the subject of this entry.
context.zh: 带有贬斥文字的后世肖像呈现此条目土地与币制政策的推行者王莽。

context.en: Gu Jianlong’s later painting commemorates Yu Qian, the minister who directed Beijing’s defense.
context.zh: 顾见龙的后世画像纪念指挥北京保卫战的大臣于谦。

context.en: The commemorative portrait identifies Yu Qian, whose execution forms part of this account of Yingzong’s restoration.
context.zh: 纪念像标识于谦，他的遇害是此处明英宗复辟叙述的一部分。

context.en: The Ming portrait depicts Ban Chao, who dispatched Gan Ying in the mission discussed here.
context.zh: 明代画像呈现班超，即条目所述派遣甘英出使的人物。

context.en: This later standing portrait commemorates Ban Chao, whose final return to Luoyang is the subject of the entry.
context.zh: 这幅后世立像纪念本条目叙述晚年返回洛阳的班超。

context.en: The album commemorates Han Yu, whose memorial against the Buddha relic led to the exile described here.
context.zh: 像册纪念韩愈；此条目叙述他因谏迎佛骨而遭贬谪。

context.en: The traveler’s costume in this later portrait offers a visual reading of the poet whose Hanzhong journey is described here.
context.zh: 后世肖像中的行旅装束，为条目叙述汉中经历的诗人陆游提供视觉解读。

context.en: This Qing portrait remembers Lu You, the poet whose final testament To My Sons is discussed in the entry.
context.zh: 这幅清代画像纪念陆游，条目讨论他的绝笔诗《示儿》。

context.en: The later book portrait commemorates Wen Tianxiang, the examination candidate named in this entry.
context.zh: 后世图传纪念此条目中参加殿试的文天祥。

context.en: The 1829 portrait belongs to the later remembrance of Wen Tianxiang’s captivity, poetry and death described here.
context.zh: 1829年的肖像属于对文天祥被囚、作诗与遇害经历的后世纪念。

context.en: The genealogy commemorates Shen Kuo, the author of Dream Pool Essays named in this entry.
context.zh: 族谱纪念本条目所述《梦溪笔谈》作者沈括。

context.en: This Tang manuscript preserves part of the Shiji, the work whose composition by Sima Qian is discussed here.
context.zh: 此唐写本保存《史记》的一部分，条目讨论司马迁撰写该书的经历。

context.en: The photographed observatory and shadow scale are the Gaocheng measuring installation named in this account of the Shoushi calendar.
context.zh: 照片中的观星台与测影长尺，正是此处《授时历》叙述点名的告成观测设施。

context.en: The Ming portrait commemorates Zhang Liang, the adviser honored with the title Marquis of Liu in this entry.
context.zh: 明代画像纪念此条目中受封留侯的谋臣张良。

context.en: This later portrait identifies Zhang Liang, one of the advisers named in the account of the Hongmen banquet.
context.zh: 此后世画像呈现鸿门宴叙述点名的谋臣之一张良。

context.en: The kendi’s spout and handleless form make the entry’s discussion of porcelain for Asian drinking practices concrete.
context.zh: 军持的流与无柄器形，使条目有关瓷器适应亚洲饮水习惯的讨论具体可见。

context.en: The right-hand portrait commemorates Guo Ziyi, the Tang commander named in the recovery of the two capitals.
context.zh: 右页肖像纪念收复两京叙述中点名的唐军统帅郭子仪。

context.en: Han Xin, shown at left in the later album, is the commander named in this account of Jingxing.
context.zh: 后世像册左页的韩信，是此井陉战役叙述中点名的统帅。

context.en: The facing portraits name Han Xin and Xiao He, both central figures in the account of Han Xin’s execution.
context.zh: 对开肖像题名韩信与萧何，两人均为韩信被杀叙述中的核心人物。

context.en: Ouyang Xiu sent this surviving letter from his retirement at Yingzhou, directly connecting the document with the place and life stage in this entry.
context.zh: 欧阳修退居颍州期间寄出此存世尺牍，直接连接条目所述地点与人生阶段。

context.en: Liu Bang, at right in this later album, is the Gaozu encircled at Baideng.
context.zh: 后世册页右侧的刘邦，即白登被围的汉高祖。

context.en: Li Jing, at left in the album opening, commanded the 630 campaign against the Eastern Turks.
context.zh: 册页左侧的李靖指挥了630年对东突厥的战役。

context.en: The later album portrait identifies Liu Zongyuan, whose Yongzhou exile and landscape essays are central to this entry.
context.zh: 后世册页标识柳宗元；本条以其永州贬谪及山水散文为中心。

context.en: This personal letter is by the reformer Wang Anshi. The linked 1069 crop-loan memorial is a separate policy document.
context.zh: 私人书札出自改革者王安石之手；延伸阅读的1069年青苗法奏议是另一份政策文献。

context.en: NPM identifies the standing ruler as Li Cunxu, founder of Later Tang in 923. The painting’s date is unknown.
context.zh: 故宫将立像人物辨为923年建立后唐的李存勖；画作年代未定。

context.en: The standing portrait is of Li Cunxu, whose Later Tang court at Luoyang is the subject of this entry.
context.zh: 立像表现李存勖，本条以其后唐政权及洛阳朝廷为主题。

context.en: The Longmen relief commemorates Xiaowen, whose capital move and reforms are described here. It was carved after his death.
context.zh: 龙门浮雕纪念本条迁都与改革的主角孝文帝，雕刻完成于其身后。

context.en: The named Ming portrait represents Wang Jian, commander in the conquest of Zhao, not his son Wang Ben.
context.zh: 明代题名画像表现参与灭赵的王翦，而非其子王贲。

context.en: The Qing portrait represents Liu Yu, who founded Liu Song in 420.
context.zh: 清代画像表现420年建立刘宋的刘裕。

context.en: Liu Yu’s later portrait is associated with the founding of Liu Song at Jiankang, rather than all four subsequent dynasties.
context.zh: 刘裕的后世画像对应建康建立刘宋这一事件，而非此后四个王朝的全部历史。

context.en: The 1893 illustration represents Fu Jian, whose accession and appointment of Wang Meng are described here.
context.zh: 1893年插图表现本条所述即位并任用王猛的苻坚。

context.en: Fu Jian commissioned Wang Meng’s campaign. This later portrait represents the ruler, not the fighting at Ye.
context.zh: 苻坚命王猛出征；后世画像表现君主，而非邺城战斗。

context.en: The later portrait represents Fu Jian, ruler of Former Qin during the campaigns summarized here.
context.zh: 后世画像表现这些战役期间的前秦君主苻坚。

context.en: The 1893 named portrait represents Huan Wen, commander of the 347 campaign against Cheng-Han.
context.zh: 1893年题名画像表现347年灭成汉战役的统帅桓温。

context.en: The 1609 book portrait names Li Houzhu, the Li Yu who inherited Southern Tang in 961.
context.zh: 1609年刊本题名“李后主”，即961年继承南唐的李煜。

context.en: The later portrait represents Li Yu, the Southern Tang ruler who surrendered to Song in 975.
context.zh: 后世画像表现975年向宋投降的南唐君主李煜。

context.en: Ma Tai’s 1928 illustration is a later depiction of Zhou Yu at Red Cliffs. The historical account also records Huang Gai’s crucial fire attack.
context.zh: 马骀1928年插图为周瑜在赤壁的后世描绘；史书记载黄盖在火攻中的关键作用。

context.en: Segalen’s 1914 photograph records sculpture at Huo Qubing’s tomb, the funerary commemoration discussed in this entry.
context.zh: 谢阁兰1914年照片记录霍去病墓雕刻，对应本条所述陵墓纪念。

context.en: The eighteenth-century album portrays Wu Zetian, the sovereign whose Zhou dynasty is the subject here.
context.zh: 十八世纪册页描绘本条武周政权的君主武则天。

context.en: The eighteenth-century portrait represents Wu Zetian, who proclaimed Zhou in 690.
context.zh: 十八世纪画像表现690年建立周朝的武则天。

context.en: Wu Zetian’s later portrait supplies the ruler whose abdication ended Zhou in 705.
context.zh: 武则天的后世画像表现705年退位、结束武周统治的君主。

context.en: The late-Ming illustration names Huang Chao, who occupied Chang’an and established a Qi government.
context.zh: 晚明插图题名黄巢，即占领长安并建立齐政权者。

context.en: The Southern Song portrait identifies Han Shizhong, one of the commanders who opposed the Miao–Liu coup.
context.zh: 南宋画像标识参与平定苗刘兵变的将领韩世忠。

context.en: Han Shizhong commanded the Song forces at Huangtiandang.
context.zh: 韩世忠是黄天荡战事中的宋军统帅。

context.en: The 1922 studio photograph is a later likeness of Sun Yat-sen, provisional president at Nanjing in 1912.
context.zh: 1922年照相馆照片为1912年在南京就任临时大总统的孙中山之较晚肖像。

context.en: Sun Yat-sen is the provisional president described here; the photograph was taken in 1922, not at the 1912 inauguration.
context.zh: 孙中山为本条所述临时大总统；照片摄于1922年，不是1912年就职现场。

context.en: Mao is the leader named in this 1949 entry. The photograph shows his 1972 meeting with Nixon, not the founding ceremony.
context.zh: 毛泽东为本条1949年建国叙述中的领导人；照片记录1972年与尼克松会见，而非开国大典。

context.en: Anonymous Yuan-dynasty painting of Wang Zhaojun’s departure, many centuries after the marriage alliance of 33 BCE.
context.zh: 元代佚名《明妃出塞图》，绘于公元前33年和亲事件数百年后。

context.en: Li Zongwan’s Qing-dynasty depiction of Su Wu, with a Qianlong imperial inscription. It recalls Han captivity from an eighteenth-century viewpoint.
context.zh: 清励宗万绘苏武故事，附乾隆御题；以十八世纪视角追忆汉代被拘经历。

context.en: First sheet of Zhu Xi’s Letter on Government Affairs, written in the eighth lunar month of 1194 after leaving Tanzhou.
context.zh: 朱熹《政事帖》第一幅，写于1194年农历八月离任潭州之后。

context.en: First sheet of Zhu Xi’s Letter on Government Affairs, written in the eighth lunar month of 1194 after leaving Tanzhou.
context.zh: 朱熹《政事帖》第一幅，写于1194年农历八月离任潭州之后。

context.en: Official photographed section 11 of Huang Gongwang’s Wuyongshi scroll, worked on from 1347 and inscribed in 1350.
context.zh: 黄公望《富春山居图》无用师卷的官方第11段摄影；作品自1347年起经营，1350年题记。

context.en: Anonymous painting probably copied in the Yuan dynasty and later mounted in an album; it evokes the pavilion associated with Wang Bo’s Tang prose.
context.zh: 佚名楼阁图，馆藏说明认为可能为元代摹本，后收入画册；对应王勃唐代名篇所写的滕王阁。

context.en: The portrait and facing biography frame Liu Yuxi as a poet worth remembering in Qing China.
context.zh: 肖像与对页传记呈现清代对刘禹锡这位唐代诗人的追忆。

context.en: The philosopher also practiced painting and calligraphy. The museum identifies Ni Zan’s influence in this quiet composition, expanding the biography beyond Wang’s teaching and public career.
context.zh: 这位思想家亦从事书画；馆方指出宁静构图受到倪瓒影响，使其生平不止于讲学与政治活动。

context.en: The heading explicitly announces completion of the two Jinchuan campaigns. Its formal praise records the court’s celebration of military success and should be read as a partisan voice.
context.zh: 题首明确写“平定两金川大功告成”；颂词记录宫廷如何庆祝战事，应作为具有立场的当时声音阅读。

context.en: The label identifies Gao Shi, the poet in the Fengqiu officeholding story. This imagined assembly of Tang scholars shows his later reputation, not an actual shared journey or the county appointment.
context.zh: 题名明确辨识封丘任职故事中的高适；唐代文士的想象聚会表现后世声望，并非真实同行或县尉任命场景。

context.en: The box inscription traces this conch from imperial ritual to Fuk’anggan’s Taiwan voyage and back to court.
context.zh: 原匣题记串起这件法螺从宫廷仪式、随福康安渡海赴台，到返回宫廷的经历。

context.en: Buildings, trays and workers organize silk production into household spaces. Follow how the painter connects separate tasks.
context.zh: 建筑、器具与劳动者把蚕织生产安排在家庭空间中。观察画家如何连接不同工序。

context.en: This is one of the inscribed ritual vessels central to the Zhou entry’s account of offices and political authority. The exterior photograph shows the vessel’s form; the inscription is transcribed on the linked museum page.
context.zh: 此器正是周代条目所述通过铭文记述官职与政治权力的礼器实例；外观照片展示器形，馆藏链接提供铭文内容。

context.en: The emperor shares sacrificial meat with Xu Da after praying for crops. This direct address presents the sovereign–commander relationship through a ritual gift.
context.zh: 皇帝祈谷后与徐达分享祭肉；直接称名的敕书，通过礼仪馈赠呈现君臣关系。

context.en: Metal cash remained important alongside paper instruments. This surviving Song coin supplies a contemporary material comparison for the entry’s discussion of moving, paying and representing monetary value.
context.zh: 金属钱与纸面凭券并存；这枚宋钱为条目所述货币运输、支付与价值表达提供当时实物参照。

context.en: The text responds to a local An chief’s rebuilding of a shrine and discusses moral transformation. It offers a Ming scholar’s voice within negotiations between hereditary local authority and imperial cultural ideals.
context.zh: 文字回应安氏宣慰重修祠宇，并讨论教化；在世袭地方权力与帝国文化理想的互动中，留下明代士人的声音。

context.en: The text responds to a local An chief’s rebuilding of a shrine and discusses moral transformation. It offers a Ming scholar’s voice within negotiations between hereditary local authority and imperial cultural ideals.
context.zh: 文字回应安氏宣慰重修祠宇，并讨论教化；在世袭地方权力与帝国文化理想的互动中，留下明代士人的声音。

context.en: Scissors, fabric and a shared workspace connect this poetic scene to the textile story’s stages of garment making.
context.zh: 剪刀、布料与共同工作空间，把这幅诗意图景同纺织故事中的成衣工序联系起来。

context.en: Imperial writing became a costly crafted object. The textile connects Qianlong’s collecting and commissioning to the presentation of his military record as perfect achievement, a claim made by the emperor.
context.zh: 御书化为精制织物，将乾隆的收藏与委托制作同“十全武功”的自我表述联系起来；“十全”是皇帝自身的主张。

context.en: The solitary rider carries Jinchuan victory news through a mountainous landscape. The painting makes the movement of military information its subject.
context.zh: 独骑在山地传递金川捷报；画卷以军事消息的流动为观看焦点。

context.en: The founder addresses how revenue instructions reach local offices and taxpayers. This surviving administrative text adds an imperial voice to the biography’s discussion of Ming institutions.
context.zh: 开国皇帝讨论税粮指令如何传至地方官府与纳税户；留存政务文本为其传记中的明初制度提供御前声音。

context.en: The text names local chiefs and explicitly discusses supplying troops. It gives the regional tusi framework a concrete administrative document showing the uneven practical demands of imperial rule.
context.zh: 文本点名土官并明确讨论军粮，为土司制度框架提供具体政务文书，展示帝国统治在实际资源与义务上的不均衡。

context.en: The opening names the migrating community and reports its arrival at Ili. Its language of submission reveals how the Qing court framed the movement, rather than giving the migrants’ own account.
context.zh: 开篇点明迁徙群体并记其抵达伊犁；“归顺”的措辞显示清廷如何解释此事，并非迁徙者自身的叙述。

context.en: The named gift makes the court relationships following the Torghut migration tangible. The inscription falls two years after the 1771 arrival; the image concerns a later tribute encounter, not the journey itself.
context.zh: 具名贡物使土尔扈特迁徙之后的宫廷关系可见；题记在1771年抵达的两年之后，图画呈现后续进贡交往，而不是迁徙途中。

context.en: Blue outlines and coloured enamel coordinate decoration below and above the glaze. Figures and plants bring literary taste into a small vessel used in Ming material life.
context.zh: 青花线条与彩绘协调釉下、釉上的装饰，人物与花木把文人趣味带入明代日用小器。

context.en: Rock masses rise through bands of mist, with paths, trees and buildings leading the eye between near and distant views. Guo Xi’s court landscape creates an imagined world that people could inhabit.
context.zh: 山石穿过层层烟岚，路径、树木和建筑引导视线往来于近景与远景。郭熙的宫廷山水营造出可居游的想象世界。

context.en: Tiny travellers move beneath a towering rock face. Compare this dramatic change in scale with Guo Xi’s shifting viewpoints; the museum distinguishes Fan Kuan’s life away from official service from Guo’s court career.
context.zh: 微小行旅从巨岩之下经过。可将强烈的尺度反差同郭熙不断转换的视点对照；馆方区分范宽未仕的生涯与郭熙的宫廷经历。

context.en: An empty pavilion, broad water and distant hills separate the near and far banks. The inscription turns this private landscape into a social gift, with its original recipient’s identity still uncertain.
context.zh: 空亭、宽阔水面与远山隔开近岸和彼岸，题诗则使私人山水成为赠答之礼；原受赠者身份仍未确定。

context.en: Figures and branches gather at one corner, leaving an expanse of open space for the gaze to travel. The imperial couplet joins poetry to this intimate court landscape.
context.zh: 人物与树枝聚于一角，大片留白让视线游移；御题诗句使诗歌与精微的宫廷山水相连。

context.en: Long bare branches and a few pale blossoms leave much of the page open. The museum identifies Zhu Da as a Ming imperial descendant who became a monk after the dynasty fell.
context.zh: 长枝疏花留下大片空白。馆方记朱耷为明宗室后裔，明亡后出家。

context.en: The shallow form and crackled glaze reward close looking. The catalogue distinguishes its current Guan-ware attribution from the Ru-ware label on a later wooden stand, which is not pictured here.
context.zh: 浅器形与开片釉面值得细看。馆藏把如今的官窑定名与后配木座上的汝窑旧题区分；本图未展示木座。

context.en: The inscription explicitly orders inconsistent measures to be unified. It directly documents the Qin entry’s standardization policy, while the vessel outline shows the practical measuring object carrying that order.
context.zh: 铭文明确要求度量不一者统一，直接对应秦条目的标准化政策；器形拓影显示承载诏令的实际量器。

context.en: The named text is the literary work central to the Chuzhou entry. A Ming calligrapher’s careful transcription shows its continuing readership centuries after Ouyang’s local service.
context.zh: 此篇正是滁州条目的核心文学作品；明代书家精心抄写，展示欧阳修任职数百年后的持续阅读与传播。

context.en: Large regular characters and imperial seals frame a celebration of Qing victory. The emperor’s political language records official commemoration from the conquering court’s perspective.
context.zh: 端整大字与御玺包围着清军报捷文字。皇帝的政治语言记录征服一方的宫廷纪功。

context.en: A later artist turns Lü Bu’s mediation between rival forces into a display of archery. Read beside the biography’s unstable alliances, the scene shows how martial skill became a memorable way of telling his story; it is not a contemporary likeness.
context.zh: 后世画家把吕布在敌对军队之间的调停，表现为射术展示；与传记中不稳定的联盟并读，可见武勇如何成为讲述其故事的鲜明方式，而非当时写生的容貌。

entryTitle.en: Cao Cao · Grain, armies and the Han court
entryTitle.zh: 曹操 · 粮食、军队与汉廷

entrySummary.en: Cao Cao's power grew from a practical problem: armies could not survive without grain, and authority could not rest on victories alone. In 196 he brought the Han emperor's court to Xu and promoted agricultural colonies to provision his forces. This combined control of the court with a claim to act in the dynasty's name. At Guandu, attacks on Yuan Shao's supplies helped break a rival coalition. Expansion southward then met an alliance led by Sun Quan and Liu Bei at Red Cliffs. The setback left several centers of power in place. Reading his career through food, appointments and alliances makes it more intelligible than treating him as either a flawless strategist or a single villain.
entrySummary.zh: 曹操的权力建立在实际难题之上：军队离不开粮食，权威也不能只靠胜仗。196年，他将汉帝朝廷迁到许县，并推行屯田，为军队提供供给。控制朝廷与以汉朝名义行事，成为相互支撑的政治手段。官渡之战中，攻击袁绍粮运帮助他击破敌方联盟。随后向南扩张，却在赤壁遇到孙权与刘备的联合抵抗，战后多方势力继续并存。从粮食、官职与联盟来理解曹操，比把他写成无所不能的谋略家或单一反派，更能解释其成败。

entryTitle.en: Liu Bei · Building a state from shifting alliances
entryTitle.zh: 刘备 · 在变化的联盟中建国

entrySummary.en: Liu Bei moved through the fractured Han world by gathering followers and negotiating with stronger powers. Alliance with Sun Quan checked Cao Cao in 208, but cooperation did not settle their competing claims to Jingzhou. In the west, Liu Zhang invited him into Yi Province; their partnership became a war that ended with Liu Bei taking Chengdu. He proclaimed himself emperor in 221, presenting his state as a continuation of Han after Cao Pi's accession. An attack on his former ally Sun Quan then ended in defeat at Yiling. His final arrangements entrusted the young Liu Shan to Zhuge Liang and Li Yan. The career reveals how promises of restoration could coexist with territorial ambition and unstable alliances.
entrySummary.zh: 刘备在汉末分裂的局势中聚集追随者，与强势力量周旋。208年，他与孙权联合阻止曹操，但合作没有解决双方对荆州的竞争。向西发展时，刘璋邀请他进入益州，合作却转为战争，最终由刘备占领成都。221年，曹丕称帝之后，他也登基，以延续汉朝为建国理由。随后进攻旧盟友孙权，却在夷陵战败。临终时，他把年幼继承人刘禅托付给诸葛亮与李严。这段经历显示，恢复旧朝的政治承诺，如何与争夺领土、维持不稳固联盟同时存在。

entryTitle.en: Zhuge Liang · Administration behind a strategist’s fame
entryTitle.zh: 诸葛亮 · 谋略名声背后的治理

entrySummary.en: Zhuge Liang's work joined diplomacy, taxation, military supply and political counsel. He helped secure cooperation with Sun Quan, then supported Liu Bei's government at Chengdu. After Liu Bei died, he became the central administrator under Liu Shan and pursued campaigns intended to challenge Wei. Supply remained a persistent problem: the final campaign included soldiers farming near the Wei River to sustain a longer presence. The first northern expedition had already shown the consequences of failed command at Jieting. His memorials connect loyalty with responsibility for results. The annotated Sanguozhi also rejects some spectacular tales later attached to him. The historical official is most interesting where plans encounter distance, resources and other people's decisions.
entrySummary.zh: 诸葛亮的工作横跨外交、赋税、军粮与政治劝谏。他帮助促成与孙权的合作，又在成都支持刘备政权。刘备死后，他成为刘禅朝廷的主要执政者，并通过北方战役挑战魏国。供给始终是难题，最后一次出兵时，他安排军士在渭水附近耕作，以便长期驻扎。此前第一次北伐的街亭失利，已经显露指挥失误的后果。他的表文把忠诚与承担成败责任联系起来。《三国志》注还驳斥了某些附会于他的神奇故事。把计划放回距离、资源和其他人的选择之中，才更能看到这位历史人物。

entryTitle.en: Zhu Yuanzhang: rebuilding institutions and concentrating authority
entryTitle.zh: 朱元璋：重建制度与集中权力

entrySummary.en: Zhu Yuanzhang founded the Ming in 1368 and pursued a government that reached from the emperor’s court into village registration and local schools. Early measures established county granaries and promoted Confucian education. The lijia system introduced in 1381 organized households for administrative obligations, making local communities part of the state’s machinery. These institution-building projects accompanied an increasingly concentrated form of rule. The purge of Hu Weiyong in 1380 and the abolition of the chief minister’s position drew more decisions toward the emperor. His reign therefore links rebuilding after dynastic conflict with coercion and political suspicion. Schools and registers tell one part of that story; the destruction of officials and their networks tells another.
entrySummary.zh: 朱元璋1368年建立明朝，推动一种从皇帝朝廷延伸到乡村登记和地方学校的治理。早期措施兴设县级粮仓、推广儒学教育；1381年实行的里甲制度，把户籍与行政义务组织起来，使地方社区进入国家运转体系。这些制度营建伴随权力进一步集中。1380年胡惟庸案及丞相职位的废除，使更多决策直接归于皇帝。他的统治把王朝战乱后的重建与强制、政治猜忌联系起来：学校和簿册讲述其中一面，官员及其关系网络遭摧毁又呈现另一面。

entryTitle.en: Taizong: advice, conquest and imperial authority
entryTitle.zh: 唐太宗：纳谏、征服与皇权

entrySummary.en: Li Shimin became Emperor Taizong in 626 after helping his father establish Tang rule. His government expanded imperial power through campaigns as well as administration. Yet the advice he prepared for his heir in 648 turns attention to a different problem: how should a ruler hear criticism and choose the people who govern? The text presents self-restraint and attention to counsel as duties of kingship. It is a statement of governing ideals by an emperor, with a particular audience and purpose. Placed beside the career of his general Li Jing, it shows how military success and the language of responsible rule worked together in the early Tang court.
entrySummary.zh: 李世民帮助父亲建立唐朝后，于626年即帝位，是为唐太宗。战争与行政建设共同扩展了皇权，但他648年为继承者撰写的训诫，把注意力转向另一问题：君主应如何听取批评、选择治理国家的人？文中把节制自身与接受谏言视为君主的责任。这是一位皇帝面向特定读者表达的治国理想，具有明确的写作目的。与将领李靖的经历相对读，可以看到早唐朝廷如何把军事成就与负责治国的语言结合起来。

entryTitle.en: Sun Quan · Holding the lower Yangzi together
entryTitle.zh: 孙权 · 经营长江下游

entrySummary.en: Sun Quan inherited his brother Sun Ce's position in 200, but the territories and commanders he inherited did not form a settled kingdom. Building authority meant retaining experienced officers, negotiating with local elites and using force against communities beyond effective control. At Red Cliffs, he backed resistance to Cao Cao and cooperation with Liu Bei. Their alliance later fractured over Jingzhou, before further diplomacy restored cooperation against Wei. Sun Quan's imperial proclamation in 229 gave these regional arrangements a dynastic name: Wu. His story shifts attention from a single famous battle to the political work that kept a southern state operating among powerful neighbors, competing officials and communities with their own interests.
entrySummary.zh: 200年，孙权继承兄长孙策的地位，但接手的土地与将领并不构成一个已经稳定的王国。他需要留住有经验的军政人员，与地方精英合作，也对控制范围之外的群体动用武力。赤壁战前，他支持抵抗曹操，并与刘备联合。后来双方因荆州决裂，又通过外交重新合作抗魏。229年称帝，使这些区域性的经营拥有“吴”的王朝名号。他的经历把视线从一场著名战役移向持续的政治工作：如何在强邻、相互竞争的官员及各有诉求的地方群体之间，维持一个南方政权。

entryTitle.en: Sima Yi · From Wei commander to family power
entryTitle.zh: 司马懿 · 从魏臣到家族权力

entrySummary.en: Sima Yi served the Cao-Wei state before his family displaced it. Campaigns and court appointments gave him authority across military and civil affairs. In 238 he conquered the Gongsun regime in Liaodong; the Jin history records extensive killing after Xiangping fell, alongside its praise of his generalship. The decisive move at the center came in 249, when he seized control while Cao Shuang accompanied the emperor to the Gaoping tombs. Promises of retirement were followed by executions. Further repression secured his position before his death in 251. He did not reign as emperor during his lifetime. The imperial title used by the Jinshu belongs to the dynasty his descendants later founded and shapes its retrospective account.
entrySummary.zh: 司马懿先为曹魏效力，后来其家族取而代之。战役与朝廷任命使他掌握横跨军政的权力。238年，他征服辽东公孙氏政权；《晋书》在赞扬统兵能力的同时，也记载襄平陷落后的大规模杀戮。249年，曹爽陪皇帝谒高平陵时，他在京城夺取控制权。许以免官退居的安排，随后转成诛杀。进一步镇压反对力量后，他于251年去世。司马懿生前并未当皇帝，《晋书》所用帝号来自其后人建立王朝后的追尊，也影响了史书回顾其生涯的方式。

entryTitle.en: Yue Fei: a Song commander and the changing meaning of loyalty
entryTitle.zh: 岳飞：宋朝将领与忠诚含义的变化

entrySummary.en: Yue Fei entered the Song army in 1122 and rose through warfare against the Jurchen Jin and other armed opponents. His military service belonged to a divided political world in which the Southern Song court had to decide between continued fighting and negotiated survival. Recall and imprisonment in 1141 ended his command; he was executed the following year. Later temples, stories and political movements made him an enduring figure of loyalty. Historian Yue Du emphasizes that the state he served was the Song dynasty, while modern readers have given that loyalty changing national meanings. Keeping the commander beside his later reputation helps explain both a twelfth-century conflict and the uses of its memory.
entrySummary.zh: 岳飞1122年进入宋军，在对女真金朝及其他武装力量的战争中升任统帅。他所处的政治世界已经分裂，南宋朝廷需要在继续作战与议和求存之间作出选择。1141年被召回并入狱，结束了他的统军生涯，次年被处死。后来的祠庙、故事与政治活动不断把他塑造成忠诚典范。历史学者Yue Du强调，岳飞所效忠的国家是宋朝，而现代读者又为这种忠诚赋予不同的民族国家含义。将将领与后世声誉并读，有助于同时理解十二世纪冲突与历史记忆的用途。

entryTitle.en: Mud becomes a path: Su Shi and West Lake
entryTitle.zh: 湖泥成为长堤：苏轼与西湖

entrySummary.en:
Su Shi returned to govern Hangzhou in 1089. The West Lake Museum dates a major dredging project to 1090: material removed from the lake helped form the causeway later named after him. Six bridges interrupted the long embankment.

The History of Song connects his work with water supply and transport as well as the lake. What visitors admire as scenery also belongs to the history of maintaining a city. Its beauty emerged through repeated human work, not an untouched landscape.
entrySummary.zh:
1089年，苏轼再任杭州知州。西湖博物馆将一次大规模疏浚系于1090年：从湖中清出的泥土被用于筑堤，后来这条长堤以他命名。六座桥分布在长堤上。

《宋史》将这些工程同供水、运输以及湖泊联系起来。游人欣赏的景色，也是城市维护史的一部分。它的美来自反复的人力经营，并非从未改变的天然景观。

entryTitle.en: Qin: building an imperial afterlife
entryTitle.zh: 秦：建造帝国的地下世界

entrySummary.en: The first Qin emperor’s burial complex combined a large mound, planned enclosures and pits containing terracotta soldiers, horses and other objects. Construction began before the unification of China in 221 BCE. The surviving figures and weapons are evidence of military organisation and specialised production, while the overall layout echoes an imperial capital. A burial monument can therefore be read as evidence about the labour, authority and ambitions of the living.
entrySummary.zh: 秦始皇陵把巨大封土、规划整齐的围墙和兵马俑等陪葬坑组合成地下世界。工程在公元前221年统一之前已经开始。陶俑与兵器反映军事组织和专业化制作，整体布局则呼应帝国都城。观察一座陵墓，也能了解生者社会中的劳动组织、权力和愿望。

entryTitle.en: Yan Zhenqing: public duty and private mourning
entryTitle.zh: 颜真卿：公职与家难

entrySummary.en: Yan Zhenqing’s calligraphy preserves more than an admired style. The draft he wrote in 758 for his nephew Yan Jiming recalls deaths in his family during the An–Shi rebellion. Corrections and additions make the work a record of writing under the pressure of grief, as well as a text shaped by loyalty to the Tang. Another surviving letter, assigned by scholars to about 775, belongs to a less ceremonial world of communication. These works place an official’s handwriting between public responsibility and personal need. They also invite different kinds of reading: the dated mourning text anchors an event, while the letter’s date depends on historical comparison.
entrySummary.zh: 颜真卿的书法保存下来的，不只是受后世推崇的风格。758年为侄儿颜季明撰写的祭文，追忆安史战乱中的家族死亡。增补与涂改使它既是哀痛中写作的痕迹，也是带有忠于唐廷立场的文字。另一封传世信札，经学者据史事推定约作于775年，则属于较少礼仪色彩的通信世界。两类作品把官员的手迹置于公共责任与个人需要之间，也要求不同的阅读方式：祭文具有明确纪年，信札的年代则依赖历史比对。

entryTitle.en: An–Shi: a war that changed the Tang
entryTitle.zh: 安史之乱：改变唐朝的战争

entrySummary.en:
The uprising associated with An Lushan and Shi Siming brought war into the Tang heartland, including Chang'an and Luoyang. It disrupted families as well as imperial government. Du Fu's poems and Yan Zhenqing's mourning manuscript let us approach that upheaval through individual experiences.

The rebellion ended in 763, but the Tang survived until 907. The court faced powerful military governors and a changed relationship with neighbouring empires. Recovery did not restore the earlier balance of power; it also did not end Tang cultural life.
entrySummary.zh:
安禄山、史思明发动的叛乱将战争带进唐朝腹地，包括长安、洛阳。受到冲击的不仅是朝廷，还有无数家庭。杜甫的诗与颜真卿的祭文，使我们能从个人经历接近这场动荡。

叛乱在763年结束，唐朝却一直延续到907年。朝廷面对势力强大的节度使，与邻近帝国的关系也发生变化。战后恢复没有重建此前的权力格局，也没有使唐代文化生活就此终结。

entryTitle.en: Yan Zhenqing writes a requiem for his nephew
entryTitle.zh: 颜真卿书写《祭侄文稿》

entrySummary.en: After Yan Gaoqing and his son Jiming died resisting the An Lushan rebels, Yan Zhenqing sent his elder nephew Quanming to recover their remains. In 758 he wrote a requiem for Jiming. The surviving draft preserves crossed-out words and shifts from regular to running and cursive script, bringing a family’s wartime loss into the history of calligraphy.
entrySummary.zh: 颜杲卿与儿子季明在抵抗安史叛军时遇难后，颜真卿派长侄泉明前往收殓遗骸。758年，他为季明写下祭文。传世文稿保留涂改字句，楷、行、草笔法交织，使一个家族的战乱创痛留在了书法史中。

reviewBasis.reviewMethod: Individually read assembled entry and cited source; portrait/date or surviving-document relationship stated explicitly; reassessed after V18 source-backed story correction

context.en: Li Bai in a thirteenth-century painting. He met and travelled with Du Fu in 744; scholars differ on whether their first meeting was in Luoyang or Chenliu.
context.zh: 十三世纪绘画中的李白。他在744年与杜甫相会同游；初次相会地点是洛阳还是陈留，学界有不同看法。

entryTitle.en: Li Bai, Du Fu and Gao Shi travel through Liang and Song
entryTitle.zh: 李白、杜甫与高适同游梁宋

entrySummary.en: In 744, Du Fu met Li Bai, then travelled with him and Gao Shi through Liang and Song, around present-day Kaifeng and Shangqiu. The meeting is placed at Luoyang or possibly Chenliu. Du Fu and Li Bai travelled together again in Shandong in 745 before parting at the end of that year.
entrySummary.zh: 744年，杜甫结识李白，随后与李白、高适同游梁宋，即今开封、商丘一带。相遇地点一般记为洛阳，也可能是陈留。745年，杜甫与李白又同游山东，至年底分别。

reviewBasis.reviewMethod: CUHK Press chronology supports named meeting and travel; it explicitly allows Chenliu instead of Luoyang; reassessed after V18 source-backed story correction

context.en: The Ming portrait introduces the Yongle emperor who commissioned the encyclopedia, placing imperial patronage beside the scholars’ work of gathering and copying texts.
context.zh: 明代御容介绍下令编纂《永乐大典》的永乐帝，让读者在学者搜集、抄录典籍的劳动之外，也看到宫廷资助的角色。

entryTitle.en: An encyclopedia that preserved parts of lost books
entryTitle.zh: 保存失传书籍片段的《永乐大典》

entrySummary.en:
A first compilation disappointed the Yongle emperor. The enlarged project brought scholars together in Nanjing to gather earlier writings into a manuscript reference work, completed in 1408. Readers found entries through a system based on sounds and rhymes.

Its survival tells another story. A later copy was made in 1562–1567, and most volumes eventually disappeared. Surviving portions preserve quotations from some books otherwise lost. An enormous collection could preserve knowledge while remaining difficult for most people to consult.
entrySummary.zh:
第一版汇编未令永乐帝满意，扩充后的工程将学者聚集在南京，收集前代著述，编成1408年完成的手写类书。读者通过音韵系统查找条目。

它的存世过程又是另一段故事：1562—1567年抄成的后世副本，其多数书册也逐渐散失。幸存部分保存了一些已经失传的书籍引文。庞大的收藏能够保存知识，同时又可能让大多数人难以查阅。

reviewBasis.reviewMethod: The exact assembled encyclopedia story names the Yongle emperor; the Palace Museum biography records the project beginning in Yongle 1. The portrait is patron identity, not a manuscript specimen.

context.en: The Ming portrait identifies Zhu Di, the Prince of Yan whose challenge to his nephew’s government opened the Jingnan war.
context.zh: 明代御容标识朱棣；身为燕王的他向侄子朝廷发起挑战，开启了靖难战争。

entrySummary.zh: 燕王朱棣于北平起兵发动“靖难之役”

reviewBasis.reviewMethod: The Palace Museum biography describes the reduction of princely power, the Prince of Yan’s rising and the ensuing three-year war before 1402.

context.zh: 这幅明代御容标识朱棣：他在1402年攻取南京，夺取帝位，次年改元永乐。

entryTitle.en: Jingnan Campaign: Zhu Di captures Nanjing and ascends as the Yongle Emperor

entrySummary.zh: 靖难之役：燕王朱棣攻克南京，即位为明成祖

context.en: The portrait identifies the emperor behind the move to Beijing. Palace construction was completed in 1420, followed by the formal transfer of the capital in 1421.
context.zh: 画像标识推动迁都北京的皇帝。宫殿于1420年建成，1421年正式迁都。

entrySummary.zh: 明成祖朱棣建北京紫禁城成，正式自南京迁都北京

reviewBasis.reviewMethod: The Palace Museum explicitly separates the late-1420 completion of the palaces from the following year’s formal move. This narrow distinction is retained in the connection.

context.en: The Ming image identifies the Yongle emperor, whose final northern expedition ended with his death at Yumuchuan in 1424.
context.zh: 明代御容标识永乐帝，他最后一次北征以1424年在榆木川病逝告终。

reviewBasis.reviewMethod: The Palace Museum records his northern campaigning and 1424 death at Yumuchuan. The image is imperial identity rather than a deathbed or campaign scene; exact expedition count is not independently established here.

entrySummary.zh: 高平之战：赵匡胤身先士卒稳住后周阵脚，反击大破北汉军

context.en: Angkor Wat makes the entry’s royal landscape visible: temple building joined political authority to religious devotion within a much wider inhabited city.
context.zh: 吴哥寺让本条所述王室景观具体可见：寺庙营建把政治权威与宗教奉献联系起来，并属于更广阔的有人居住的城市。

entryTitle.en: Angkorian courts: power across a managed landscape
entryTitle.zh: 吴哥诸宫廷：经营景观中的权力

entrySummary.en:
Angkor’s royal centers belonged to a succession of Khmer courts, not one city frozen at the height of its power. Monuments, settlements and water-management works show the organization of resources across an inhabited landscape. Different rulers sponsored different religious projects and associated royal authority with changing forms of devotion.

Building and maintaining this environment required farmers, craftspeople and labor obligations as well as kings. The movement of political centers did not mean that every earlier settlement was abandoned immediately. Angkor’s surviving monuments also represent only part of the society that supported them. A political overview connects the existing site entry to institutions and changes of authority, while avoiding an empire-wide polygon inferred solely from the distribution of temples.
entrySummary.zh:
吴哥的王室中心属于先后出现的高棉宫廷，并非一个永远停留在权力顶峰的城市。纪念建筑、聚落和水利设施，显示资源如何在有人居住的景观中被组织。不同统治者资助不同宗教工程，并把王权同变化中的信仰形式相联。

营造和维持这一环境，不仅需要国王，还依靠农民、工匠与劳役。政治中心迁移不意味着所有旧聚落立即废弃，存世纪念物也只代表支撑社会的一部分。政治概述把已有遗址条目同制度及权威变化相连，而不只根据寺院分布推定帝国全境。

reviewBasis.reviewMethod: Read saved UNESCO Angkor description and modern photograph. Exact named royal-capital landscape is central to the assembled summary; no automatic association with every Khmer ruler.

context.en: Bagan’s surviving temples give physical form to the relationship between royal authority, merit-making and many acts of patronage described here.
context.zh: 蒲甘留存的寺庙，为本条所述王权、积累功德与众多赞助行为之间的关系提供了实体景观。

entryTitle.en: Bagan: kingship and the institutions of merit
entryTitle.zh: 蒲甘：王权与功德制度

entrySummary.en:
Bagan became the center of a regional empire during the eleventh through thirteenth centuries. Royal authority and Buddhist merit-making were expressed through temples, monasteries, images and the resources assigned to religious institutions. These were working institutions sustained by people, land and skilled production rather than an isolated collection of monuments.

The surviving buildings allow comparison among different patrons and devotional forms. They do not imply that every construction was ordered by a king or that royal influence remained geographically constant. Religious activity continued as political centers and relationships changed. Linking the established Bagan place record to a political phase therefore explains institutional context while preserving the difference between the court’s period of prominence and the longer life of the sacred landscape.
entrySummary.zh:
十一至十三世纪，蒲甘成为区域帝国的中心。王权与佛教积累功德的实践，通过寺塔、僧院、造像和分配给宗教机构的资源表达。这些并非孤立纪念物的集合，而是由人口、土地与专业生产维持的运作机构。

存世建筑可以用于比较不同施主和礼拜形式，却不意味着每项营建都由国王下令，或王权影响的地理范围始终不变。政治中心和关系改变后，宗教活动仍持续。把已有蒲甘地点条目同政治阶段相连，可以解释制度背景，同时区分宫廷显赫的时期与神圣景观更长的生命。

reviewBasis.reviewMethod: Read saved UNESCO statement on Bagan’s eleventh–thirteenth-century regional capital and merit-making. The exact site and historical building landscape are the record’s subject.

context.en: Dholavira is one of the cities named in this Indus overview. Its reservoir makes the practical work of storing water visible within the wider urban network.
context.zh: 多拉维拉是本条印度河城市概览明确列举的城市之一。蓄水池让城市网络背后的储水工程具体可见。

entryTitle.en: Indus civilization · Cities and regional networks
entryTitle.zh: 印度河文明 · 城市与区域联系

entrySummary.en:
Around 2600–1900 BCE, large settlements including Mohenjo-daro and Dholavira formed part of a wider Indus or Harappan archaeological tradition. Street plans, wells, drains and craft production offer evidence of different forms of urban life. Shared material styles and connections do not prove that all cities belonged to one centrally ruled empire. Researchers continue to debate the relationships among settlements and how political authority was organized.

The surviving archaeological evidence does not provide a complete account of rulers, languages or beliefs. The map point identifies one illustrative city. It is not a reconstruction of the extent of Indus settlement, a migration route or an ethnic boundary.
entrySummary.zh:
约公元前2600—前1900年，摩亨佐达罗和多拉维拉等大型聚落属于更广泛的印度河或哈拉帕考古传统。街道、井、排水设施和手工业遗存呈现不同的城市生活；物质风格和联系相似，并不能证明所有城市都属于一个中央集权帝国。研究者仍在讨论聚落之间的关系和政治权力如何组织。

现存考古证据不能作为对统治者、语言或信仰的完整记载。地图点只标示一处示例城市，不复原聚落范围、迁徙路线或族群边界。

reviewBasis.reviewMethod: Read saved UNESCO Dholavira description of Harappan urban planning and reservoirs; the exact city is explicitly named in the entry’s account of wells and drainage.

context.en: Hampi’s stone chariot shrine belongs to the capital landscape described here, showing how Vijayanagara’s temples joined skilled production with ceremonial life.
context.zh: 亨比的石车神龛属于本条所述都城景观，呈现毗奢耶那伽罗寺庙如何结合工匠技艺与礼仪生活。

entryTitle.en: Vijayanagara: a regional empire with several successors
entryTitle.zh: 毗奢耶那伽罗：区域帝国与多个继承者

entrySummary.en:
Vijayanagara connected a large southern Indian political sphere with the capital landscape now associated with Hampi. Temples, markets and water works supported an imperial center whose prosperity depended on surrounding agriculture, circulation and service. Its rulers negotiated, fought and formed alliances with neighboring Deccan powers; religious labels alone do not explain those changing relationships.

The 1565 defeat and damage to the capital were a turning point, but not the disappearance of every successor court or political institution associated with Vijayanagara. This overview therefore separates a capital-centered imperial phase from a longer and more fragmented aftermath. Reading it beside Bahmani and successor sultanate entries helps explain a shared regional world. The representative capital does not supply a fixed boundary for every year of the interval.
entrySummary.zh:
毗奢耶那伽罗把南印度广阔的政治世界与今称亨比的都城景观相连。寺庙、市场与水利服务帝国中心，而其繁荣依赖周边农业、流通与劳动。统治者同德干邻国谈判、交战和结盟，宗教标签不足以解释这些不断变化的关系。

1565年的失败和都城受损是转折，却不代表所有继承宫廷和相关制度立即消失。本条因此区分以都城为中心的帝国阶段与更长、更分散的后续历史。与巴赫曼尼及其继承苏丹国并读，可理解共享的区域世界。代表性都城点位不能提供整个时段逐年的固定疆界。

reviewBasis.reviewMethod: Read saved UNESCO Hampi statement identifying the Vijayanagara capital and Vitthala temple stone chariot. Exact capital-site relation is substantive, not generic dynasty matching.

context.en: Nalanda was one of the Buddhist institutions supported by Pala rulers. This modern view makes that named place of teaching and patronage tangible.
context.zh: 那烂陀是波罗统治者支持的佛教机构之一。这张现代照片，使本条具名的教学与赞助场所具体可见。

entryTitle.en: Pala: Buddhist courts in Bengal and Bihar
entryTitle.zh: 波罗王朝：孟加拉与比哈尔的佛教宫廷

entrySummary.en:
Pala kings ruled in eastern South Asia while other dynasties competed for power elsewhere in the subcontinent. Their support for Buddhist institutions connected royal authority to teaching, worship and the production of images. Nalanda received patronage, and other monastic complexes formed part of this landscape.

Sculpture and manuscript traditions from eastern India circulated beyond an individual court. This makes the Pala story useful for comparing political succession with religious networks: the loss of a dynasty did not erase the institutions, artistic practices or communities associated with it.
entrySummary.zh:
波罗诸王在南亚东部统治的同时，其他王朝也在次大陆各处争夺权力。王室支持佛教机构，将政治权威与教学、礼拜和造像联系起来。那烂陀得到资助，其他寺院群也构成这一文化景观。

东印度的雕塑与写本传统并不限于单一宫廷。波罗历史因而适合用来比较政治更替与宗教网络：王朝失去统治，并不等于相关机构、艺术实践或社区随之消失。

reviewBasis.reviewMethod: The Met timeline explicitly states Pala patronage of Nalanda; saved UNESCO page and asset metadata establish this as Nalanda. No individual visible brick course or temple phase is assigned to a Pala king.

context.en: Nan Madol’s basalt walls make the Saudeleur ceremonial centre visible, connecting the entry’s account of authority with the labour of monumental construction.
context.zh: 南马都尔的玄武岩墙使绍德雷尔礼仪中心具体可见，把本条的权威叙述与大型营建所需的劳动联系起来。

entryTitle.en: Saudeleur authority: a ceremonial center on Pohnpei
entryTitle.zh: 绍德雷尔权威：波纳佩的礼仪中心

entrySummary.en:
Nan Madol’s monumental building phase offers evidence of a political order whose authority was expressed through residences, tombs and ceremony. The Saudeleur chiefs made this lagoon city a center of government and ritual. A museum synthesis describes chiefs living beside commoners and potential rivals being required to reside near the ruling center. The arrangement linked social rank to the built environment.

This political overview complements the site entry: it asks who mobilized labour and how ceremonial life helped sustain authority. Oral histories and excavated remains provide different kinds of evidence, which can be compared without treating either as an annual frontier map. The focus on buildings dated chiefly to 1200–1500 does not establish the dynasty’s exact beginning or end, or imply uniform control over every community on Pohnpei.
entrySummary.zh:
南马都尔的大型营建阶段，为一种以住宅、墓葬和仪式体现权威的政治秩序提供了证据。绍德雷尔首领以这座潟湖城市为统治与礼仪中心。博物馆研究描述了首领与平民共同居住、潜在竞争者被要求迁近统治中心的安排，社会等级由此与建筑空间相连。

本条补充遗址介绍，关注谁动员劳力，以及礼仪生活如何维系权威。口述历史与考古遗存提供不同类型的材料，可以比较，却不能直接变成逐年疆界图。约1200—1500年的建筑分期，不等于王朝确切的起讫，也不表示波纳佩所有社区始终受到同等控制。

reviewBasis.reviewMethod: Read saved UNESCO description explicitly identifying Nan Madol as the Saudeleur ceremonial centre and its basalt construction. Same exact political centre, not a general Pacific illustration.

context.en: The Great Stupa and its stone railings place Sanchi’s donor inscriptions within the sanctuary they helped support. The view shows the monument rather than a close-up of one donor’s text.
context.zh: 大塔与石栏把桑奇施主铭文放回他们支持的圣地之中。照片呈现建筑整体，并非某位施主铭文的特写。

entryTitle.en: Names on the stone: the donors of Sanchi
entryTitle.zh: 刻在石上的姓名：桑奇的施主

entrySummary.en:
Dhamarakhitā of Madhuvana appears at Sanchi through a brief record of a gift. Other inscriptions name monks, nuns and lay donors, sometimes adding a home town, occupation or teacher. Their short texts turn stone railings and monuments into traces of many participants. A sanctuary associated with royal patronage was also sustained by people whose names rarely enter dynastic histories.

Studies of the first-century BCE inscriptions draw particular attention to women’s contributions. Giving allowed donors to participate in a religious community and leave a durable acknowledgement of that participation. The records do not provide complete household budgets or explain every donor’s motives. Their strength is more concrete: they preserve named acts of support. Read them beside the monuments and the scale of the work changes, from the ambition of a ruler to the accumulated gifts of a wider community.
entrySummary.zh:
来自Madhuvana的女性施主Dhamarakhitā，以一则简短的捐献记录出现在桑奇。其他铭文记有僧人、比丘尼与在家施主，有时还注明家乡、职业或师承。石栏和建筑上的短句，因此保存了许多参与者的痕迹。一处与王室赞助相连的圣地，也由那些很少进入王朝史的人共同支持。

研究公元前一世纪铭文的学者尤其注意到女性的贡献。捐献让施主参与宗教社群，并留下持久的记载。这些文字没有完整的家庭收支，也未解释每位施主的动机；它们能够具体证明的，是一次次有名可考的支持行为。把铭文与建筑并读，工程的历史便从君主的事业扩展到众多成员逐步积累的赠予。

reviewBasis.reviewMethod: Read exact donor story and saved UNESCO Sanchi description of railings, gateways and inscriptions. Admitted as the named sanctuary’s setting, not as a legible image of Dhamarakhitā’s inscription.

context.en: Mohenjo-daro is another city named in this overview. Its Great Bath offers a concrete comparison with Dholavira’s reservoir: two different uses of water in Indus urban life.

entryTitle.zh: 印度河文明 · 城市与区域联系

Researchers continue to debate the relationships among settlements and how political authority was organized.

The surviving archaeological evidence does not provide a complete account of rulers, languages or beliefs. The map point identifies one illustrative city. It is not a reconstruction of the extent of Indus settlement, a migration route or an ethnic boundary.

约公元前2600—前1900年，摩亨佐达罗和多拉维拉等大型聚落属于更广泛的印度河或哈拉帕考古传统。街道、井、排水设施和手工业遗存呈现不同的城市生活；物质风格和联系相似，并不能证明所有城市都属于一个中央集权帝国。研究者仍在讨论聚落之间的关系和政治权力如何组织。

context.en: Ashoka’s inscribed pillar at Lumbini, photographed in 2023, gives a surviving example of the Mauryan royal inscriptions and Buddhist patronage discussed here.
context.zh: 2023年拍摄的蓝毗尼阿育王铭文石柱，为条目所述孔雀王朝王室铭文与佛教供养提供了存世实例。

context.en: The Lumbini pillar records Ashoka’s visit to a Buddhist pilgrimage place around 249 BCE. This 2023 photograph shows one of his surviving inscriptions, distinct from the Kalinga edict discussed in the biography.
context.zh: 蓝毗尼石柱记录阿育王约公元前249年到访佛教朝圣地。2023年的照片呈现其存世铭文之一，与传记所述羯陵伽诏令是不同文本。

context.en: Lumbini’s Ashokan pillar, dating to the third century BCE and photographed in 2023, illustrates the entry’s distinction between early Buddhist traditions and later royal evidence for pilgrimage.
context.zh: 蓝毗尼阿育王石柱属于公元前三世纪，照片拍摄于2023年。它使条目对早期佛教传统与后来王室朝圣证据的区分具体可见。

context.en: The cover of Kate Sheppard’s 1893 franchise report for the New Zealand Women’s Christian Temperance Union connects the voting-rights victory with the organized campaign behind it.
context.zh: 凯特·谢泼德为新西兰妇女基督教禁酒联合会撰写的1893年选举权报告封面，将投票权的取得与背后的组织运动联系起来。

context.en: Sanchi’s carved gateway, railing and Great Stupa, photographed in 2013, illustrate the stone architecture compared with later devotional images in this entry. This is Sanchi in central India, not Gandhara or Mathura.
context.zh: 2013年拍摄的桑吉雕刻门楼、围栏与大塔，呈现条目用来与后来供奉造像比较的石质建筑。这是印度中部的桑吉，并非犍陀罗或马图拉。

context.zh: 唐德宗在这册后世帝王图像的左页，右页为唐玄宗。他正是783年兵变后出奔奉天、贯穿本篇叙事的皇帝。

context.en: The Song imperial album portrays Gaozong at right, with his identification at left. It introduces the ruler whose court took refuge around Wenzhou in 1130.
